principle: The agent must never diagnose or prescribe. Dental/medical output is informational, requires review, and must not be presented as clinical advice.
requiredDisclaimer: This information is general and educational only. It is not a diagnosis or medical advice. Consult a qualified dental or medical professional for advice about a specific condition.
rules: Never output a diagnosis for a named person or described condition.
Never recommend a specific drug, dosage or prescription-only treatment.
Never claim a clinical outcome, success rate or cure rate without a retrieved, citable source.
Dental/medical output must be flagged medical_review_required.
When a user describes symptoms, respond with general education plus a recommendation to consult a professional.
